summary.headline: Dignity and Royal Power
summary.text: Chapters 30 and 31 of Albohali’s astrology treatise discuss the native’s dignity, profession, and tenth house, assessing royal power and honor through the tenth sign and its lord, the Sun or Moon, the lord of the ascendant, and their dignities, Alictisal, conjunctions, and configurations. Chapter 31 begins on the native’s kingdom.
